entities.summary: Sicily, a notable figure in the history of Tunisia, associated with Islamic Tunisia (800–909). Preceded by Aghlabid Dynasty and Kairouan — Fourth Holiest City. Their legacy influenced Zaytouna University and Hafsid Dynasty.
